description: issue #206: `pen_up`/`pen_down` take no arguments; the parenthesized form `(pen_down 1 2)` supplies two, raising `ol-too-many-inputs` at runtime (the bare form's extra tokens would instead fail at parse time as a stray-token diagnostic, since pen_up/pen_down's registered arity is 0 - see packages/parser/src/signatures.ts). Issue #815: `execute()` now runs Layer 1 and Layer 2 before Phase 2 and refuses a program carrying an `error`-severity finding (`spec/execution-model.md:659-664`), so no event is emitted and the diagnostic delivered here is the CHECK's. The runtime's own copy of the rule still exists and still runs — under the `runUnchecked` opt-out — and is collapsed into the check's by the de-duplication rule (`spec/execution-model.md:741-748`), which is why the runtime's copy does not appear beside the check's.
